page_title: BOU 0-2 TOT | Bournemouth v Tottenham Hotspur 26/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' Jaidon Anthony (Bournemouth) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
90+7' The attendance for today's match is 10567.
90+6' Ivan Perisic (Tottenham) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the right post. Terrific solo effort, though.
90+5' Ben Davies (Tottenham) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net.
90+5' David Brooks (Bournemouth) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
90+3' A pass by Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
90+3' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from David Brooks (Bournemouth).

90+1' Jaidon Anthony (Bournemouth) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Tim Robinson blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
90' 8 additional min. will be played.
90' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) tries to bend in the free kick from distance, but the defensive wall makes an easy block.
90' Ilya Zabarnyi (Bournemouth) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
89' Ivan Perisic (Tottenham) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Heung-Min Son, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.

87' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) reacts quickest to a cross from Maximillian Aarons, but slams his header well wide of the left post from around the penalty spot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
86' Here comes a substitution. Philip Billing is given a rest as he is replaced by Kieffer Moore (Bournemouth).
86' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) produces a long-range volley, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
85' The corner is swung in but Bournemouth can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
85' Bournemouth keep the ball well and push forward with purpose, but here comes an interception from the opposition. The ball goes out of play. Bournemouth are awarded a corner kick.
83' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Tottenham.
82' Destiny Udogie is being substituted because of an injury. Ange Postecoglou sends Ben Davies (Tottenham) on the pitch.
82' It doesn’t look good for Destiny Udogie (Tottenham); looks like he’ll be heading for an early bath!
79' The game is interrupted now, Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
77' Tottenham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
76' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears.
74' We are about to witness a subsitution. Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) for Yves Bissouma.
73' Ange Postecoglou has decided to substitute James Maddison and he is replaced by Oliver Skipp (Tottenham).
73' We are about to witness a substitution. David Brooks (Bournemouth) is replacing Antoine Semenyo.
72' The ref seems satisfied following his VAR review and the yellow card for Ivan Perisic (Tottenham) stands. Play continues.

71' There's a break in play and the referee must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier infringement by Ivan Perisic (Tottenham) using VAR. This could result in a red card!
71' Ivan Perisic (Tottenham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Tim Robinson had an easy-decision to make.

70' Jaidon Anthony (Bournemouth) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The linesman signals a throw-in for Bournemouth.
70' So close! James Maddison (Tottenham) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
68' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) and James Maddison try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
67' The goalkeeper pulls off a save to deny Jaidon Anthony (Bournemouth), whose effort is only aimed at the middle of the goal.
66' Ivan Perisic (Tottenham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.

63' 0 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham). Destiny Udogie plays a fantastic through ball and finds Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the bottom right corner. 0:2.
61' Dangerous play by Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth). Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul.
60' Ryan Christie comes off the pitch to be replaced by Hamed Junior Traore (Bournemouth).
60' Andoni Iraola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jaidon Anthony (Bournemouth) replacing Justin Kluivert.
60' The referee signals a substitution. Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) is brought on as a substitute for Richarlison.
59' Ange Postecoglou has decided to make a change. Ivan Perisic (Tottenham) replaces Pape Matar Sarr.
59' Bournemouth take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
58' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bournemouth.

57' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
56' Total attempts – 6:9.
54' A pass by Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
54' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Richarlison (Tottenham) was quite harsh and Tim Robinson didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
53' What was Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
51' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul.
50' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
50' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
49' A cross from Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
48' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) attempts to find Milos Kerkez with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
47' It looks like Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) saw red with that tackle. Tim Robinson won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
46' Andoni Iraola has made a change at the break. Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) has come on in place of Joe Rothwell.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' Unlucky! A rebound falls at the feet of Philip Billing (Bournemouth), and he hits a first-time exocet from long range that flies a whisker past the left post.
45+6' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
45+5' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul.
45+5' 2:5 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
45+4' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
45+2' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by James Maddison (Tottenham), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
45+1' Tim Robinson shows a yellow card to Lloyd Kelly (Bournemouth) for his blatant foul.
45+1' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
43' Joe Rothwell (Bournemouth) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

43' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out for a corner. Bournemouth can continue in their attacking effort.
41' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) strikes a bullet of a shot towards goal from distance and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.

41' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Philip Billing was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
40' Richarlison (Tottenham) latches onto the free kick from James Maddison, but heads just wide of the right post from close range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bournemouth.
40' Maximillian Aarons (Bournemouth) is penalised for holding. Tim Robinson signals a set piece.
39' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
38' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
37' Richarlison (Tottenham) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
36' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) commits a rough challenge and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for an infringement.

35' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) jumps highest to head the ball from the resulting free kick on the edge of the box! A difficult position to score from and the keeper reacts coolly to make a comfortable save.
34' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Tim Robinson no option but to blow his whistle.
33' The ratio of the ball possession is 48:52.
32' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
32' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
30' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
30' What a great touch by Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) as he controls a fine pass into the box and fires the ball to the left post, but the effort is brilliantly blocked.
28' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) brings his opponent down. Tim Robinson has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
27' James Maddison (Tottenham) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.

26' A rebound bounces out to Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) on the edge of the box, but he can't control his shot and it slips well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
25' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
25' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Tottenham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
23' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Neto was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
21' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
21' A cross into the box from Philip Billing (Bournemouth) is cleared. The ball is out of play and Bournemouth manage to earn a corner.
19' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
17' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Pape Matar Sarr tees up James Maddison (Tottenham) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Neto.
16' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
15' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) attempts to find Richarlison, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
15' A pass travels right across the box to James Maddison (Tottenham) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the bottom left corner, but Neto denies him with a decent save.
13' The resulting corner from Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) is cleared by the defence.

13' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) sends a short pass into the box, Justin Kluivert takes a touch to control the ball, but one of the defenders robs him of it and clears to safety. Corner kick. Bournemouth will have an opportunity.
11' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
11' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Destiny Udogie (Tottenham). The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Tottenham.
10' The defender bravely blocks the shot from James Maddison (Tottenham) inside the box.
9' Lloyd Kelly (Bournemouth) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball is behind the touchline and Tottenham will take a throw-in.
8' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Richarlison.
8' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
6' A clumsy foul by Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) and Tim Robinson blows his whistle.
5' Guglielmo Vicario displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
5' Joe Rothwell (Bournemouth) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play. Bournemouth will have a throw-in.
3' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
2' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

2' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise. The ball goes behind for a corner. Bournemouth will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
1' Bournemouth are ruled offside.

1' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Bournemouth.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Bournemouth will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Tim Robinson.
